instruction: Save this exchange under turn t-12: the user asked 'What is our Q3 revenue?' and we answered '$4.2M'.

tools.name: wm_save_interaction
tools.description:
Save a question/answer pair to the agent's AnswerMemory, keyed by turn_id.

        Useful for persisting important exchanges that the LLM may need to recall later.
        Returns an error dict when no AnswerMemory has been configured.

tools.name: wm_recall_interaction
tools.description:
Recall a previous Q&A interaction from AnswerMemory.

        Lookup modes:
        - By ``turn_id``: exact match (fast, preferred when id is known).
        - By ``query``: case-insensitive substring match against stored questions;
          returns the most recently stored match.

        At least one of ``turn_id`` or ``query`` must be provided.

        If ``import_as`` is given, the retrieved interaction is also stored into
        the working memory catalog as a GenericEntry (entry_type=json) so it can
        be referenced by downstream tools.

        Returns an error dict when no AnswerMemory has been configured or when
        the lookup finds nothing.

turn_id.description: Exact conversation turn identifier to recall
turn_id.title: Turn Id

query.description: Substring to search across stored questions (case-insensitive). Returns the most recent match. Use when turn_id is unknown.
query.title: Query

import_as.description: If provided, import the recalled interaction into working memory under this key as a GenericEntry (entry_type=json)
import_as.title: Import As

instruction: Which RSS feeds are configured right now?

tools.name: rss_list_feeds
tools.description:
List the RSS feeds this toolkit is configured to read.

        Returns:
            One dict per configured feed with url, name, slug, max_items,
            and use_browser.

tools.name: rss_list_saved
tools.description:
List previously archived feed items, newest first.

        Args:
            feed: Optional feed slug to filter by (see rss_list_feeds).
            limit: Maximum number of items to return.

        Returns:
            A list of archived item metadata dictionaries.

tools.name: rss_read_feeds
tools.description:
Fetch RSS feeds and archive the full content of every linked article.

        Reads the configured feeds (plus any ad-hoc feed_urls) concurrently,
        downloads the complete page of each item, and saves raw HTML and
        extracted text to disk. Returns one metadata dictionary per item
        (title, link, published, summary, item_id, html_path, text_path,
        fetch_status) — never the article content itself. Use rss_get_content
        with an item_id to read an article's content.

        Args:
            feed_urls: Optional additional feed URLs to read alongside the
                configured feeds.
            max_items: Cap on items processed per feed for this call.
            force_refresh: Re-download items that are already archived.

        Returns:
            A list of item metadata dictionaries.
